papers.title: Effects of UV-A exposure on the growth and the biochemical composition of Gracilaria gracilis (Rhodophyta)
papers.authors: Aziz Ben Ghedifa, Julia Vega, Félix L. Figueroa, Saloua Sadok, Fethi Mensi
papers.key_findings: This paper investigates the effects of UV-A exposure on the growth and biochemical composition of Gracilaria gracilis, a type of red algae. The study finds that UV-A exposure affects the growth and biochemical composition of the algae.
papers.methodology: The study used controlled laboratory experiments to expose Gracilaria gracilis to UV-A radiation and measured the effects on growth and biochemical composition.
papers.relevance: This paper is not directly relevant to MarsLab's Mars exploration goals, as it focuses on the effects of UV-A radiation on a type of algae on Earth.
